scope.authorized_actors: Designated IAS team members and accounts
scope.authorization: May open and operate assigned IAS project chats/work sessions on behalf of Human Leadership, subject to the current authoritative Gate and Execution Mode.

current_permissions.WS-00: REVIEW scope only: governance REWORK/correction/verification is authorized.
current_permissions.WS-01: GO: substantive Workflow & Event Contract work is authorized within canonical contract scope.
current_permissions.WS-02..WS-11: BLOCKED: chat may be opened for mandatory preflight, read-only analysis, planning, test/mock preparation, and dependency clarification only. No implementation writes to owned workstream paths, no release, and no shared-contract redefinition until explicit valid unlock/GO is recorded.

worker_requirements: Run Mandatory IAS Preflight before substantive work.
State workstream code, current gate, execution mode, dependencies, locks, latest orders, and next authorized action.
Publish material status with actor/account identity and evidence.
Stop immediately when a newer Human, Warden, Orchestrator, or Debugger order narrows or blocks scope.
Do not issue HUMAN directives unless Human Leadership separately delegates that authority.
